The ULTIMATE Guide to the World’s Largest & Most Notable Islands by Region! ✨🌊
From tropical paradises to icy wildernesses — explore Earth’s most iconic islands! 🌏👇
📍 OCEANIA / PACIFIC
• New Guinea – Wild, diverse & shared by two nations
• Borneo – Home to orangutans & ancient rainforests
• Hawaii (Big Island) – Volcanoes & aloha spirit!
• New Zealand: North & South Islands – LOTR vibes!
• Plus: Fiji’s Viti Levu, Samoa’s Savai’i, French Polynesia’s Bora Bora 💙

📍 ASIA
• Sumatra & Java – Powerhouses of biodiversity
• Luzon & Mindanao – Heart of the Philippines
• Japan’s Big 4: Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu, Shikoku
• Hainan & Taiwan (disputed)
• Socotra – Alien dragon’s blood trees! 🌵
📍 EUROPE
• Iceland – Fire & ice wonderland
• Great Britain & Ireland – Celtic legends
• Mediterranean Gems: Sicily, Sardinia, Corsica, Crete, Rhodes, Corfu
• Baltic/North: Gotland, Zealand, Mallorca, Ibiza, Menorca
📍 NORTH AMERICA
• Baffin Island – Canada’s Arctic giant
• Long Island & Isle Royale – Wild USA
• Caribbean: Cuba, Hispaniola (Haiti/DR), Jamaica, Bahamas, Barbados
📍 SOUTH AMERICA
• Tierra del Fuego – “End of the World” (Chile/Argentina)
• Marajó Island – Amazon Delta, Brazil
• Optional add: Galápagos (Ecuador) for notability
📍 AFRICA
• Madagascar – Lemurs & unique wilderness!
• Zanzibar, Pemba, Mafia – Swahili spice islands
• Bioko, São Tomé and Príncipe – Atlantic gems
📍 ARCTIC & SUBARCTIC
• Greenland – World’s largest island (2.16M km²!)
• Canada: Devon, Ellesmere, Victoria Islands
• Russia: Novaya Zemlya, Franz Josef Land
• Svalbard – Polar bears & North Pole gateway! 🐻‍❄️

📍 ANTARCTIC
• Alexander Island – Antarctica’s giant
• South Georgia – King penguin kingdom
• Kerguelen, Heard & McDonald Islands – Windswept wonders
📌 Fun Facts:
✅ Greenland = largest island (not continent)!
⚠️ Some islands are disputed territories.
💬 Which island is on your bucket list? Drop a 🌴 or 🏔️!
🔁 Share if you love island adventures!
👉 Follow for daily geography gems!

[5:10PM] #CBDMarina  #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along Inner Marina Road is moving smoothly from the UBA Roundabout toward the NNPC Filling Station, continuing inward to the Cathedral Church and NITEL intersection.

There is perfect vehicular flow from the State House toward McWen Bridge, with a good connection to Force Road.

Movement is also swift from underneath the Zone 2 Bridge heading toward the Flag Staff House and onward to McWen Bridge.

Traffic from Onikan Roundabout by TBS toward the Water Board and linking the NITEL intersection remains steady and free-flowing.

Broad Street traffic is good from the General Hospital through Tinubu Square, connecting Abibu Oki Street inward Apongbon.

Similarly, the entire stretch of Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street inward Ganiu Smith Street is experiencing smooth movement.
Our personnel are on ground and actively managing traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:34PM] #Ojo #TrafficUpdate

Movement from Iyana Era to Afromedia is smooth, and traffic from Afromedia through Iyana Iba toward Volks is even better. Both the Iyana Iba flyover heading toward Mile 2 and the underpass route heading toward Igando are moving well.
Volks to Barracks is seamless, while Barracks through Abule Osun, Trade Fair, and down to Abule Ado is progressing as expected. No disruptions reported, and traffic officers are actively managing the flow to maintain order on the roads.

#FollowLASTMA
